evidence.excerpt: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: By systematically varying SynthAPI's generation controls in 458,752 tasks across 849 trained models of four different sizes, we derive a scaling law that predicts downstream tool-use agent generalization based on the scale and composition of the synthesized environments.
